text:
sam: Quick heads-up — after deploying a TF change that updated the serviceAccount annotation for vec-staging, ~20% of pods started failing KMS decrypts.
taylor: @sam can you paste the pod log line and the svcacct annotation you applied?
sam: sure — logs:
```
ERROR: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/eks-pods/... is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456
```
sam: svcacct annotation:
```
eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vec-staging-irsa
```
lia: Did you push the terraform change for the iam_role or only the k8s SA?
sam: TF diff included role and aws_iam_role_policy_attachment. But we applied k8s manifests first.
taylor: ^that's likely — IRSA mapping needs the role trust policy to allow sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, and the key grant must include the role ARN if we grant via grant/principal.
lia: Can you paste the TF snippet for the key grant?
sam: ```hcl
resource "aws_kms_grant" "vec_decrypt" {
  name = "vec-staging-decrypt"
  key_id = data.aws_kms_key.vec_key.id
  grantee_principal = aws_iam_role.vec_irsa_role.arn
  operations = ["Decrypt"]
}
```
devops-oncall: KMS grants are eventual — grants can take a few seconds but usually okay. More common issue is using role ARN vs principal string mismatch (if role has path or session tags).
taylor: Also check the IAM role's assume_role_policy: `Principal: {Federated: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks..."}` and that the serviceAccount annotation matches the token issuer.
sam: I also saw STS session name in audit logs showing session name from pod not matching a condition in our key policy — we added a sessionTag constraint in the key policy recently.
lia: If the key policy condition restricts by `aws:userid` or session tags that can block. Suggest temporary policy relax: add a key policy statement that allows the role ARN explicitly, or relax the condition to match sesssion tags.
taylor: Quick workaround: rollback k8s manifest so pods re-run with old annotation and confirm decrypts. Long-term: update TF to attach grant after role creation and add a key policy statement for the role ARN (not session tags), or update grant to use the exact principal string that matches sts audit.
sam: Rolling back now. Also opening a PR to change grant ordering in TF: create role and policy attachments, then create grant. ping @lia for review.
infra-bot: deploybot: rollback started for vectorizer-staging @ 2026-03-17T14:22Z :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
devops-oncall: Let me know when rollback finishes, I'll tail logs and confirm decrypts.
taylor: Also consider switching to KMS key policy statements that explicitly allow the role to decrypt (so you're not reliant on grant ordering), or use a small umbrella statement to allow the role ARN.
sam: thx — will follow up in PR with TF plan and var changes.
